senses.gloss: f.(b. h.; נָכַר Hif.) recognition.—הכָּרַת העובר recognition of the embryo, certainty of pregnancy.
units: Nidd. 8ᵇ; Y. Yeb. IV, 6ᵃ; a. e.—הכרת פנים that by which a face is recognized, means of identification; nose, features. Y. Sot. IX, 23ᶜ bot. from the nose, מקום ה׳ פ׳ the place of identification. Y. Yeb. XVI, 15ᶜ; Gen. R. s. 65, a. e. העביר ה׳ פניהם של ישראל he (Abijah) mutilated the features of Israelites (slain in battle).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Niddah 3:2:5">Y. Nidd. III, 50ᶜ</cite> <he>עד שתצא ה׳ פניו</he> until that portion of the fetus comes to light by which its nature can be ascertained.
